pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions are primarily sub-polygonal with slightly rounded vertices and moderately sharp edge gradients. The spatial area of patches is largest on the mid-flank and decreases toward the neck region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous network of thin pathways. Junction nodes typically feature three or four intersecting paths with relatively uniform pixel thickness throughout the visible flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated profile with a textured silhouette against the background.
